== Chronology and source audit (issue 414) ==

The chronology links 31 original set-release entries and 92 update or dated-sheet milestones, with 541 card-event entries. These are occurrences, not a count of distinct cards or new text versions. Repeated website/forum notices were reconciled; the later Imperial Entanglements notice supplies the confirmed 20 July 2017 effective date.

=== Possibly faulty data ===

* [[Virtual Modern release and update history#2022-12-22-errata|Macroscan]]: the contemporary 22 December 2022 notice blanks it. The current PC retrospective list places it in July 2023.
* [[Virtual Modern release and update history#2023-07-15-blanking|Ralltiir Operations]]: the contemporary 15 July 2023 notice blanks the Set 10 version. The retrospective list places it in December 2022. Both sources are retained in the chronology's references.
* [[Virtual Modern release and update history#2019-12-16|Young Skywalker]]: the December 2019 announcement gives 16 December tournament legality for the previews and the related withdrawal; March 2020 records the withdrawal again. The later record is not a second blanking.
* [[Virtual Modern release and update history#decree-blog|Imperial Decree]]: the website notice is dated 11 September 2015; the same replacement text appears in a forum notice displayed 3 October, whose UTC instant is 4 October. Both are cited; they are not separate text versions.
* [[Virtual Modern release and update history#set7-blog|Imperial Entanglements]]: the initial blog discussed prospective 19 July legality; the later forum notice explicitly sets 20 July. The chronology uses the confirmed date.
* Slip Sliding Away: the official workbook's Set 10 entry conflicts with the printed Set 12 source and the existing Modern article (212_4). The printing source takes precedence.

=== Missing data ===

The exact first announcement or paper-effective day remains unestablished for the March 2022 flip-card sheet, December 2023 and August 2025 updates, and the March, May and September 2026 paper updates. Month-only sheet dates and announcement dates remain separate from effective dates. GEMP deployment and PDF filenames are not substituted for paper legality. The Fall 2019 Dark Hours entry is a dated-sheet occurrence, not a claim that its first errata took effect on the sheet's date.

The following historical printing targets need the Modern version work on issue 257. Existing Legacy homonyms or later replacement cards were not substituted:
* A Good Blaster At Your Side & Restricted Deployment: No exact Set18comboarticle found; AGood Blaster At Your Side is a different Set0Effect.
* Anakin's Lightsaber (V): Source explicitly blanks the Base Set/Set0 version. Existing Anakin's Lightsaber(V) is Set10 UID210_3 and cannot represent that printing.
* Drop!: This July2022event concerns the old Set3Effect. Current(V) is a later Set DDefensive Shield and baretitle is the original Decipher Coruscant Effect; neither is the affected family.
* Drop! (V) (Set3): Affected Set3Effect family remains to be resolved; current(V) is newer Set Dshield.
* Firepower (V): Affected Modern Set0shield absent; bare(V) is Legacy Virtual Shields.
* Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi & Quite A Mercenary: No exact Modern Set12comboarticle; component Help Me Obi Wan Kenobi is not equivalent.
* K'lor'slug (V): Official workbook identifies Set1 Effect, while existing K'lor'slug(V) infobox says Set0. Retained notice provides replacement Effect text but no set icon; source-set conflict not resolved.
* Macroscan (V) (Set10): Affected Set10printing family remains to be resolved; do not substitute lateredition/otherera.
* No Bargain (V): Affected Modernprinting absent in boundedexactprefixsearch; bare(V) anderrata are Legacy Block4.
* Thrown Back: This July2022event concerns the old Set3Effect. Current(V) is a later Set DDefensive Shield and baretitle is the original Decipher Coruscant Effect; neither is the affected family.
* Thrown Back (V) (Set3): Affected Set3Effect family remains to be resolved; current(V) is newer Set Dshield.
* Twilight Is Upon Me (V): Affectedretired Set12printing absent; bare(V) belongs Set22return.
* Vice Admiral Resdox: No historical named article verified. Captain Peavey is an existing Set8 successor but not substituted for the earlier named printing.
* Weapons Display (V): Affected Modern Set0shield absent; bare(V) is Legacy Virtual Shields.
* Young Skywalker: Affected retired Set8printing absent; baretitle belongs Set22return.

When an earlier text was unavailable for direct comparison, a summary describes the published replacement rule rather than inventing a before/after difference. Source text, document hashes, edition dates and individual comparison bases are retained in the issue 414 evidence.

=== Preservation ===

Live primary sources were checked and full source snapshots were prepared and queued. Save Page Now returned HTTP 520 on the PC and connection-refused errors on authenticated VPS submissions. No replay URL is presented as a preserved copy without a successful check. Capture work remains outstanding; the source queue and exact errors are retained on issue 414. The existing original Dark Hours illustration is inventoried separately; image capture and File-page preservation verification remain outstanding. Its dated Holotable composite was inspected but is not used here.
